description: The Groz X-8A Heavy Duty Grease Pump from X Series is built for high-performance lubrication in demanding environments. Engineered with precision and CNC-machined components, it delivers up to 4 gms of grease per stroke, twice the output of standard pumps. With a maximum pressure of 4000 PSI, this pump is ideal for use with heavy machinery like excavators, tractors, and industrial equipment. The unit features a spring-loaded follower plate and air release valve to minimize air lock, ensuring smooth and efficient operation. Complete with a durable 8 kg steel grease bucket, 2m rubber hose, and built-in handle, it’s the perfect solution for everyday greasing tasks.
